other_failure_modes.description: Categorical string columns are converted to integer codes independently on the train and test sets using pandas' `.cat.codes`. If the unique values differ between train and test, the integer mappings will be misaligned, corrupting the feature for the test set predictions.

summary: The agent constructs an impressively sophisticated pipeline with custom feature engineering, target encoding, and Nelder-Mead ensemble optimization. However, it suffers from two notable data science flaws: leaking test set information by computing global category frequencies prior to splitting, and critically, applying `.cat.codes` independently to the train and test sets, which leads to misaligned categorical mappings.
